query: Are Mauritz Stiller and Johannes Grenzfurthner both of the same nationality?

pipeline_result.response:
No, they are not both of the same nationality.

Mauritz Stiller (born 17 July 1883) is a Finnish-Swedish film director, best known for his discovery and collaboration with Greta Garbo in the 1920s. He was born in Vienna, Austria, while Johannes Grenzfurthner (born 1975) is an Austrian artist, filmmaker, writer, actor, curator, theatre director, and lecturer.
retrieved_context: Mauritz Stiller: Mauritz Stiller (17 July 1883 – 18 November 1928) was a Finnish-Swedish film director, best known for discovering Greta Garbo and bringing her to America.

Johannes Grenzfurthner: Johannes Grenzfurthner (] ; born 1975 in Vienna) is an award-winning Austrian artist, filmmaker, writer, actor, curator, theatre director and lecturer.  He is known as the founder, conceptualist and artistic director of monochrom, an international art and theory group.  Most of his artworks are labelled "monochrom".

Carl Heinrich Graun: Carl Heinrich Graun (7 May 1704 – 8 August 1759) was a German composer and tenor singer.  Along with Johann Adolph Hasse, he is considered to be the most important German composer of Italian opera of his time.
